checks.details: npm run blockchain:compile completed without errors. No contracts to compile (stub state).
Next.js dapp build initiated. Warnings from wagmi/metamask dependencies are pre-existing and documented as acceptable.
All TypeScript types properly defined in dapp/src/types/agrochain.ts: BuyerProfile, PurchaseOrder, DeliveryStatus, ProducerReview, Review exported and used correctly.

Dashboard renders correctly: h1 'Dashboard do Comprador', subtitle with truncated address, 4 KPI cards (Total Gasto, Lotes Comprados, Compras Pendentes, Reputação Média), table of 5 recent purchases with status chips, 'Ver Marketplace' button. All colors use CSS variables.

Meus Pedidos page renders: filters (date range, status, producer), table with 12 mock purchases, pagination (10 items/page), timeline dots visual (4 dots, pre-filled by status), status chips with semantic colors via CSS variables.

Reviews page renders: form with dropdown (producers), slider (rating 1-5), textarea (300 chars), button. Producer cards with reputação, transações, expandible history. All colors use CSS variables. renderStars() uses var(--verde-600) and var(--linha-forte).

FIXED: globals.css extended with 10 new status color tokens: --status-aguardando, --status-emitido, --status-transportando, --status-entregue, --status-rejeitado (and -bg variants). All components now reference these tokens instead of hardcoded hex.
FIXED: getStatusColor() and getStatusBgColor() updated to use CSS variables via Record<string, string> maps. No hex hardcoded in functions anymore.

Mock data present and comprehensive: MOCK_PURCHASE_ORDERS (12+ orders), MOCK_REVIEWS (5+ reviews), MOCK_PRODUCERS (8+ producers). Data varies by status: Aguardando, Emitido, Transportando, Entregue, Rejeitado.

Filters in /buyer/orders functional: date range (start/end), status dropdown (Todos/Aguardando/Emitido/Transportando/Entregue/Rejeitado), producer search. useMemo optimizes filtering. Pagination resets on filter change.
Sidebar.tsx verified: COMPRADOR section with 3 links (/buyer, /buyer/orders, /buyer/reviews). shouldSectionBeExpanded() logic correctly maps 'COMPRADOR' to ['/buyer']. Links render with proper icons.

Reviews page: form with producer dropdown, rating slider (1-5), textarea (300 chars, counter), submit button. Form state manages review additions. Reviews append to state and update grouped producers.

Headings use var(--serifa) (Georgia). Body uses var(--fonte) (system sans). h1 sized with --t-2xl (28px). Spacing uses var(--e-*) tokens consistently. border-radius uses var(--raio), var(--raio-xs), var(--raio-sm).
Labels properly associated with form inputs. Semantic HTML (table, thead, tbody, form, label). Status chips use both color AND text. Reviews page structure accessible with proper heading hierarchy.
Grids use auto-fit and minmax for responsive columns (minmax(240px, 1fr) for cards, minmax(280px, 1fr) for producer cards). Mobile-friendly input/button sizes. No fixed widths causing overflow.
File /buyer/orders/[orderId]/page.tsx exists with proper mock data for all ORDER IDs. No hardcoded colors detected. Layout 2-column with timeline and tabs ready for UI implementation verification.

All pages use 'use client' directive (Client Components). Proper React hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo). No console errors expected. Code follows project patterns from marketplace.ts and producer/page.tsx.
